title: Impact of Inflation on Unlicensed Moneylending Cases Reported
what_it_is: Impact of Inflation on Unlicensed Moneylending Cases Reported

sections.label: Unlicensed moneylender cases and enforcement
sections.summary: Reports 917 UML cases from October to December 2021, an 8% decrease, plus police enforcement, foreign and bank cooperation, and a planned anti-UML campaign.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Between October and December 2021, there were 917 cases of UML and UML-related harassment cases reported.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This was an 8% decrease, compared to the same period in 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In 2021, the Police conducted 11 major enforcement operations and investigated a total of 1,682 subjects.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police also actively work and share information with foreign enforcement agencies to dismantle UML syndicates that are operating from outside of Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In addition, the Police work closely with the banks to disrupt the operations of UML syndicates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police are planning a new run of the anti-UML campaign to educate and remind the members of public on the perils of borrowing from unlicensed moneylenders.

sections.label: Police view on unlicensed moneylenders
sections.summary: States the Police monitor trends, consider the unlicensed moneylender situation under control, and will strengthen levers, education and monitoring of advertisement modes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: Indeed, the Police do monitor the current trends, but I would like to, first of all, say that we think the current situation of unlicensed moneylenders is under control.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: We will continue to look at how we can strengthen our levers and also on measures to educate the members of public on the perils of unlicensed moneylender borrowing and also monitor the modes in which unlicensed moneylenders are using to transmit the advertisements and promotion through different means.
